RPSC Sub Inspector 2021 Answer Key 2026 – Full Details

Rajasthan Public Service Commission (RPSC) has released the re exam answer key for the post of Sub Inspector / Platoon Commander. This recruitment was issued for 859 posts. The examination was held on 20 September 2026. Online applying process for Rajasthan RPSC RPSC SI / Platoon Commander Recruitment 2021 were accepted from 09 February 2021 to 23 June 2021. Candidates who had applied this form can check their RPSC SI / Platoon Commander Re Exam Answer Key 2026 which has given below.
